title: 第7章 天使投资人第8章 对赌协议
slug: 符心护剑重建三十三重天
content_zh:
苏醒还欲再问些关于位格修炼的细节，赵凯却忽然停下脚步，出声打断了他：“到了。”
苏醒一愣，抬起头，才发现两人不知何时已站在了“和平饭店”
那熟悉的门廊下。
赵凯仰头看着那块略显陈旧却擦拭得干干净净的金字招牌，眼中流露出一种混合着渴望与放松的神情，仿佛回到了自己的舒适区。
“好了，小子，问题永远是问不完的。”
赵凯咂摸了一下嘴，仿佛已经尝到了杯中之物的醇香。
“我现在只想进去喝一杯，好好放松一下。
怎么样，要跟老哥一起吗？”
这位三阶白银大地神官，竟像个孩子般下意识地吞了吞口水，显然对店里的某样东西期待已极。
苏醒张了张嘴，正准备婉拒——他得先回客房部报道——就听见一个熟悉的大嗓门从上方传来：
“苏醒！
你小子回来了还不赶紧过来告诉我结果！
躲在这里偷什么懒？你这该死的小鬼头，还有一大堆活儿没干呢！”
苏醒抬头，只见主管沃克正从二楼的一扇窗户探出身子，用力地朝他挥着手，脸上依旧是那副看似严厉、实则也严厉的表情。
几分钟后，苏醒跟着沃克主管来到了饭店四楼。
走廊铺着厚厚的地毯，脚步落在上面悄无声息，环境远比楼下客房部安静奢华。
沃克在一扇厚重的雕花木门前停下。
他并没有立刻敲门，而是转过身，面对着苏醒，伸出手仔细地替他整理了一下本就简陋的衣领和袖口，动作显得有些笨拙，却又异常认真。
他的眼神复杂难明，里面有五分的关怀，三分的羡慕，还夹杂着一分难以掩饰的嫉妒和一丝抱怨命运的不平。
“苏醒，”

沃克的声音压低了些，带着一种前所未有的郑重：
“老板在里面。
你既然成功觉醒了白银战斗职业……你的未来，从此就完全不同了。”
他顿了顿，手掌用力地拍打了几下苏醒的肩膀，力度大得几乎让人感到疼痛，仿佛想通过这种方式把所有的嘱托和期望都拍进去。
“好好把握机会……不要浪费了你的天赋。”
说完，沃克深深看了苏醒一眼，不再多言，转身离开。
他先是头颅低垂着，走着走着，头颅慢慢的抬高，背影有一种萧索又倔强的味道。
苏醒站在原地，目送着那位三年来对自己多有照顾、此刻心情复杂的主管消失在走廊尽头。
这一切的真实感，人与人之间鲜活的情感涌动，利益的算计，阶层的差异，远非冰冷的数据所能概括。
他口中不由地发出一声近乎呢喃的低语：“这不应该啊……这根本……不是一个游戏的世界。”
苏醒深吸一口气，敲响了那扇厚重的雕花木门。
“请进。”
门内传来一个有力而沉稳的声音。
他推开门，一间宽敞、奢华得超乎想象的房间映入眼帘。
各种昂贵的装饰和气派的布局尚在其次，最吸引苏醒目光的，是站在巨大办公桌后的那个人。
仅仅只是站在那里，他就像是一把出了鞘的、锋芒毕露的剑。
用“挺拔”
来形容他，都显得过于苍白。
他身材高大，身旁立着一柄与他肩高的十字双手大剑，线条刚硬，透着冰冷的杀伐之气。
他的左手随意地搭在宽大的剑颚上，这个动作显得无比自然，仿佛那柄大剑本就是他身体的一部分。

他背后是一扇巨大的落地窗，午后的阳光汹涌而入，却几乎完全被他身躯所遮挡，在他的身体轮廓四周勾勒出一圈耀眼的金边，令人难以直视。
阳光有些刺眼。
苏醒下意识地眯起眼，向前走了几步。
随着视线逐渐适应光线，他终于看清了对方的相貌。
那人梳着一丝不苟的灰白色大背头，鬓角则是更为醒目的银白，年纪约莫四五十岁，面容威严，甚至称得上英俊。
content_en:
Su Xing wanted to ask more details about personal cultivation, but Zhao Kai suddenly stopped and interrupted him: "We're here."
Su Xing was stunned for a moment, raised his head, and realized that the two of them were standing at the "Peace Hotel" at some point.
Under that familiar porch.
Zhao Kai looked up at the slightly old but clean gold-lettered signboard, his eyes showing a mixture of longing and relaxation, as if he had returned to his comfort zone.
"Okay, kid, you'll never run out of questions."
Zhao Kai smacked his mouth, as if he had already tasted the mellow aroma of the contents in the cup.
“I just want to go in and have a drink and relax.
How about it, do you want to go with me? "
This third-level silver earth priest swallowed his saliva subconsciously like a child, obviously looking forward to something in the store.
Su Xing opened his mouth and was about to decline - he had to report back to the housekeeping department first - when he heard a familiar loud voice coming from above:
"Wake up!
Why don't you come over here and tell me the results now that you're back?
Why are you hiding here and being lazy? You damn little brat, you still have a lot of work to do! "
Su Xing looked up and saw supervisor Walker leaning out from a window on the second floor, waving his hand vigorously at him, with the seemingly stern, but actually stern expression on his face.
A few minutes later, Su Xing followed Director Walker to the fourth floor of the hotel.
The corridor is covered with thick carpet, and footsteps fall silently on it. The environment is far quieter and more luxurious than the guest room downstairs.
Walker stopped in front of a heavy carved wooden door.
He did not knock on the door immediately, but turned around, faced Su Xing, stretched out his hand and carefully arranged his already simple collar and cuffs, his movements seemed a little clumsy, but extremely serious.
His eyes were complicated and difficult to understand. There were 50% concern, 30% envy, mixed with a bit of unconcealable jealousy and a trace of complaining about the injustice of fate.
"Wake up,"
Walker's voice was lowered, with an unprecedented solemnity:
"The boss is inside.
Now that you have successfully awakened the silver combat profession... your future will be completely different from now on. "
He paused, then slapped Xing Xing's shoulders hard several times with the palm of his hand, so hard that it almost hurt, as if he wanted to take in all the entrustments and expectations in this way.
"Take advantage of your opportunities...and don't let your talents go to waste."
After saying that, Walker took a deep look at Su Xing, said no more, and turned to leave.
At first, he lowered his head, then slowly raised his head as he walked, giving his back a look of desolation and stubbornness.
Su Xing stood there, watching the supervisor who had taken good care of him over the past three years and was in a complicated mood disappear at the end of the corridor.
The reality of all this, the surge of vivid emotions between people, the calculation of interests, and the differences in class are far beyond what cold data can summarize.
He couldn't help but utter a whisper that was almost a whisper: "This shouldn't be... this is not a game world at all."
Su Xing took a deep breath and knocked on the heavy carved wooden door.
"Please come in."
A strong and steady voice came from inside the door.
He opened the door, and a room that was spacious and luxurious beyond imagination came into view.
After all the expensive decorations and grand layout, what caught Su Xing's attention the most was the man standing behind the huge desk.
Just standing there, he was like an unsheathed, sharp sword.
Use "tight and straight"
To describe him, it seems too pale.
He was tall, and beside him stood a cross-handed sword that was as high as his shoulders. The lines were rigid and exuded an icy killing aura.
His left hand rested casually on the broad jaw of the sword. This action seemed extremely natural, as if the sword was part of his body.
Behind him is a huge floor-to-ceiling window, and the afternoon sunlightIt surged in, but was almost completely blocked by his body. A dazzling golden edge was outlined around the outline of his body, making it difficult to look directly at him.
The sun is a bit dazzling.
Su Xing narrowed his eyes subconsciously and took a few steps forward.
As his vision gradually adapted to the light, he finally saw the other person's appearance clearly.
The man had meticulously combed gray-white hair, and his sideburns were even more eye-catching silver. He was about forty or fifty years old, and his face was majestic, even handsome.
